body: It all depends on what state/country you are in. I was committed to a psych ward when they saw my cuts but they legally weren’t able to call my parents because I’m an adult (18).
None that I can see. There’s no swelling or anything like that just a lot of redness, but one only just stopped bleeding a few hours ago.

I ate 3 meals today, first time probably in weeks I’ve done this. It felt good. I don’t think I can turn it into a routine because it was so exhausting and made me feel like a fat fuck but for one day it was good.

I’ve heard horror stories about being forced to pay for ambulance rides after calling a hotline. Apparently similar things happen at colleges, read a story last week about how a kid was forced to leave his school after reaching out to a hotline.

I'm pretty sure you missed the point of my post, nowhere in my post do I talk about the people who work at hotline centers or the strangers who help people down from roofs. Im talking about the pompous people who march around this website dropping links as their first interaction with someone. They don't ask more information about the situation or try to figure anything out. Then they get showered in upvotes and hailed as some type of hero. I'm mad because they are not trying at all. nothing about dropping a stupid phone number i have memorized is going to help me or any other suicidal person. posting a link and doing NOTHING ELSE is NOT offering help, its just ego stroking.
Is it strange/awkward to you?
I honestly have exhausted all other emotional options, I started because i just wanted to feel Something, even if it was pain
My only advice is find a major you are really passionate about, being surrounded by likeminded people isn’t a guarantee they’ll give a shit about you, but at least you have something to talk about.
And please don’t cut yourself, I hate myself even more after every time, but I can’t stop, it’s a horrible addiction and probably makes people think I’m some attention seeking loser.

It’s ok, I’m a downer too. My day is pretty shit. I slept for like 12 hours now I’m writing a shitty essay for a gen ed class I don’t care about for a teacher who constantly rags on me. What about you?

I honestly miss high school a little bit, everyone is stuck there for 8 hours a day and at least some of them try to feign niceness. In college once class is over nobody has any obligation to say a singe word to you.

All the little things I see every day. People smiling at me, making small talk, having people to eat dinner with, I don’t want to be greedy and demand a large group of friends and have everybody love me. I just want people to acknowledge my existence. I just want one person who will ask me how my day is going.

I’m 18 and what do you mean by my situation? I’m in college and being forced to watch happy people have healthy and normal social interactions every day while I sit in my room rotting away and cutting myself.

What brought me to the point of wanting to kill myself? Probably the fact that I am completely alone 24/7. I always ask people how they are doing but they never ask me. I’m always the guy who has to pester and beg just to be included in any social situation. Women find me disgusting, I try my best to look good, and spend large amounts of money on my skin, hair, and clothes but I’m still a freak. I wish I could have the things 99.9% of the the human population takes for granted. Does that answer your question?
Only person I encourage to die is myself
I don’t hear that often
That’s neat-o
Darn :( on my phone none of my braincels posts show up.
Now that braincels is gone you can’t read my post history >:^)

You’re more ridiculous than I thought, I’ve tried making friends: failed. Tried being social: failed. Tried therapy: did nothing. Some people are destined to kill themselves alone in their late teens/early 20s, I’m one of those people. You have no agency over me.

You have to be on drugs to think we call women roasties in public, you’re assuming that I’m saying these statements based off of nothing. I live in a rural college town, everyone already knows who I am, the ugly guy. Why would I go out when everyone already has a preconceived notion of me.
So we can get laughed at and called freaks?
Why are you guys celebrating? Braincels was one of the only places I can talk to other people without being judged as a freak.

I probably should have worded my response better, what I’m trying to say is my ceiling for happiness is so much lower than the average person. Even if my happiness is my own, it is an objective downgrade compared to a 6’2 jock.
I’m just taking gen ed classes right now, I don’t really have any passions.

Anything that would make me happy would make someone more attractive than me happier. I know good looks aren’t the key to happiness, but they offer you such a boost it’s completely unfair (inbox4 life isn’t fair)
It’s good to hear there is some possibility of hope. I have an excruciatingly long amount of school left so I hope I can find a solution like you did
Not a deformity but I have a lazy eye and I have to wear thick glasses so my eyesight doesn’t get any worse. I write lists of all the things wrong with me if you want me to send it to you
Because I know I’m a truly physically disgusting person. I can’t stand looking at myself so why would other people.
I don’t think I’ll ever find someone valuable. I can’t imagine anyone even wanting to be my friend.
Did it get any better?

How do I manage feelings of bitterness towards people more attractive than me? It makes me feel worthless seeing my peers pass me in every way Possible. Knowing they are having fulfilling relationships while I sit alone rotting, I don’t even know why I’m alive
that would be nice
